title: Fractions, Units and Necessary Conditions
topics: Fractions as selected equal parts of the same whole
Equivalent fractions using the same positive-integer factor
Adding same-whole fractions in common units
Checking models, units and proposed answers
conditions: Fractions must refer to the same whole before their quantities can be compared.
Multiplying numerator and denominator must use the same positive integer.
For 1/2 and 1/3 of the same whole, use 3/6 + 2/6 = 5/6; adding the denominators gives the wrong unit.
quotes: A fraction describes selected equal parts of the same whole.
multiplying both numerator and denominator by the same positive integer changes the partition without changing the quantity.
uncertainties: The page does not specify what to do when whole sizes differ beyond describing their sizes instead of treating the fractions alone as a sufficient comparison.
The page says a correct numerical answer with an unexplained unit still needs a reasoning check, but does not specify a required check format.
